verdict.rationale: Sellers get a documented bulk catalog pipeline. A CSV feed where "each row is a product or variant" (up to 4 GB) is uploaded through the v2 Product Catalog Import API, with replace-mode deletion semantics, per-row error CSVs and succeeded/succeeded_with_errors/failed webhooks. The docs also describe bulk fulfilling agent orders through the List CheckoutSessions endpoint instead of handling each order individually. Missing for 10: bulk operations on the agent/buyer side (Link CLI spend requests are per-purchase and each needs human approval), any batch tooling in the MCP server, detail on how bulk fulfillment works beyond listing sessions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
